# Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals

> The official website of the Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals (OCCA), providing information on appellate procedures, court leadership, and criminal appeal guidance.

OCCA is Oklahoma's primary appellate court for criminal cases, handling appeals from district courts across the state. The site serves attorneys, litigants, and the public with filing instructions, court calendars, judge biographies, and procedural guidance.

## Key Topics

- Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals (OCCA)
- Criminal Appeals
- Appellate Court
- Judge Biographies
- Filing Appeals

## Court Overview & Leadership

- [OCCA – Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals](https://okcca.net): Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals homepage with court leadership and jurisdiction information
- [History of the Court – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/history-of-the-court): Historical overview of Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals structure and establishment
- [Gary L. Lumpkin – Presiding Judge – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/judges/gary-l-lumpkin): Biography of Presiding Judge Gary L. Lumpkin of OCCA
- [William J. Musseman – Vice Presiding Judge – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/judges/william-musseman): Biography of Vice Presiding Judge William J. Musseman

## Judges & Judicial Directory

- [David B. Lewis – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/judges/david-b-lewis): Biography of OCCA Judge David B. Lewis from Ardmore
- [Robert L. Hudson – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/judges/robert-l-hudson): Biography of OCCA Judge Robert L. Hudson from Guthrie
- [Scott Rowland – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/judges/scott-rowland): Biography of OCCA Judge Scott Rowland, District No. 4
- [Past Judges – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/past-judges): Historical directory of past judges of Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals

## Filing & Appellate Procedures

- [How to file an Appeal – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/how-to-file-appeal): Guide to filing criminal appeals with deadlines and procedures
- [Notice To Attorneys – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/notice-to-attorneys): Notice to attorneys regarding court procedures and filing requirements
- [Out-of-State Attorney Admissions – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/attorney-admissions-to-the-bar): Information on out-of-state attorney admissions and bar registration
- [FAQ – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/faq): Frequently asked questions about appeals, filing, and court procedures

## Court Calendar & Scheduling

- [Calendar – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/calendar): OCCA court calendar with oral arguments and case schedules

## Contact & Court Administration

- [Contact – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/contact): Contact information for Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals
- [Court Staff – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/court-staff): Complete court staff and administrative directory for OCCA
- [Orders Division – OCCA](https://www.okcca.net/orders-division): Orders Division staff directory and contact information
